question: In a code language, NEPAL is written as PGRCN, and CHINA is written as EJKPC, then how will KOREA be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9985dd8f74750c629823c3946c05df004da792102bc4f662d139761e5e452694.png] 

The logic followed here is,

NEPAL is written as PGRCN,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d736c4895f0857474502ca461347ffc629e9a3a3e911fd69548a39b061d42bef.png] 

CHINA is written as EJKPC, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dad171e1cc85e0975b07ae7880b77942ea96475996b08c810b927b95e6ce556d.png] 

Similarly,

**KOREA can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f24a5a86749801f614f259f8bed895bc1e6a18178dfc8e95cc8e6413f77b5659.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1****"**.
